item.title: Moreland scores 1,000 points for Troup High School

item.title: County to close Adams Road at Highway 18
item.description: After years of crashes and failed fixes, Troup County will close Adams Road at GA Highway 18, despite legal concerns, to address speeding and school bus safety issues.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - John Tures: Does Requiring Voter ID On Election Day Create A Partisan Advantage?
item.description: Analysis of 2024 results finds stricter voter ID states lean more GOP, while evidence shows noncitizen voting is rare and new rules risk disenfranchising eligible voters.

item.title: TOTY Kelley inspires lifelong learning
item.description: LaGrange High School Teacher of the Year Karen Kelley brings AP rigor, Mock Trial coaching and deep community service to inspire students toward lifelong learning.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - L. Michelle Moore: Doing Well by Doing Good meets the MAHA Movement
item.description: Corporate sustainability leaders and MAHA moms confront PFAS pollution and shifting regulations, seeking ways to “do well by doing good” for communities like Dalton, Georgia.

item.title: LaGrange plants trees off Hunnicutt for Arbor Day
item.description: LaGrange marks 26 years of Arbor Day by planting new trees off Hunnicutt Street and owning up to a paperwork lapse that left its official Tree City streak at 25 years.

item.title: LaGrange Academy punches ticket to state semifinals
item.description: LaGrange Academy boys beat Thomas Jefferson 62-54 behind 19 from Kayde Bradfield, advancing to the state semifinals and a Wednesday matchup with Citizens Christian

item.title: UAE Drivers Shift Toward Flexible Mobility as Long Term Rentals Gain Popularity
item.description: Life in the UAE moves fast. People relocate for work, families settle in new neighborhoods, and visitors arrive every day to explore cities across the country.
